BiblicalUsage: Okto is the number eight. The child is circumcised when eight days are accomplished in Luke 2:21 and His name is called Jesus, and in John 5:5 a man has an infirmity thirty and eight years.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe eight days mark the covenant and thirty-eight years mark the need, and Jesus meets both.
RelatedEvents: The Healing at the Pool of Bethesda
